outlook.statement: The Company is confident that it would be able to take advantage of emerging opportunities in the coming years.

India expected to be one of the top three economic powers in the world over the next 10-15 years; increasing per-capita GDP, opportunity to cross-sell services, opening of financial sectors with innovative products, low retail penetration, extensive distribution reach, strong brand recognition, changing demographic profile favoring young, adequate capitalization to support medium-term growth plans.

Market risk
Credit risk
Liquidity risk
Market risk: risk of loss of future earnings, fair values or future cash flows from changes in price of financial instruments (interest rates, foreign currency exchange rates, equity prices)

Credit risk: risk of financial loss if customer or counterparty fails to meet contractual obligations, arising from receivables, investments, inter-corporate deposits, financial guarantees, cash with banks, and credit exposure to clients
Liquidity risk: risk that the Company will not be able to meet financial obligations as they become due
Currency risk: Company has no foreign currency denominated assets, exposure is NIL
Interest rate risk: investments primarily in variable rate interest instruments, exposure is insignificant
Price risk: risk that value of financial instruments will fluctuate due to changes in market prices, from investments in Mutual Funds, listed Equity Shares, Bonds classified at cost
